title: Paris Hero Mission
subtitle: A secret hero in Paris
grammar: can / can't for abilities: I can fly. I can't swim. Can you jump? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Hero costumes: colours & clothes — My mask is red. My boots are black. spots / stripes
Places in a city + there is / there are (recycled)
Directions: turn left, turn right, go straight on; next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of
Imperatives for missions: Look at the map! Go to the park!
Present Simple recycled: Luc makes croissants every morning.

story.title: A Tiny Red Friend
paragraphs: {name} is in Paris with her mum. She is in a park. There is a big green tree.
On the tree there is a tiny red ladybird with black spots. "Hello, {name}!" says the ladybird. "My name is Pip. I can talk!"
"Wow!" says {name}. Pip smiles. "You are kind and brave. Do you want to be a secret hero? You can help people in Paris." "Yes, please!" says {name}. Now she is a hero trainee. Shh! It's a secret!

exercises.title: Spots On, Mission On!
lines: Red and black, spots on my back!
Tiny Pip is on the track!
Spots on! Mission on!
Secret hero, come along!
Paris, Paris, here I am!
Hero trainee, yes I can!

exercises.prompt: Draw Pip the ladybird on a green leaf. Pip is red with five black spots. Draw a big smile!
exercises.ru: Нарисуй божью коровку Пип на зелёном листике: красная, пять чёрных пятнышек и улыбка.

exercises.title: My Hero Powers
exercises.task: Write what you can and can't do.
exercises.ru: Напиши в тетради, что ты умеешь и чего не умеешь делать.
steps: Write the title: My Powers.
Write 3 sentences with I can.
Write 2 sentences with I can't.
Draw a ✅ or ❌ next to each sentence.
exercises.model:
My Powers

items.text: My ___ is red with black spots. 🎭
items.ru: Моя маска красная с чёрными пятнышками.

story.title: Pip's Costume Box
paragraphs: Pip has got a secret box. "Open it, {name}!" In the box there is a red mask with black spots. There is a long black cape, too.
There are red boots and black gloves. There is a yellow belt with a little star. {name} puts on the costume. She looks in the mirror.
"I'm a hero!" she says. "Not yet," says Pip. "First, training!"

exercises.title: Design Your Costume
exercises.task: Draw your hero costume and write about it.
exercises.ru: Нарисуй свой костюм героя и напиши 4 предложения о нём.
steps: Draw yourself in your hero costume.
Colour it in.
Write 4 sentences: My mask is…, My cape is…, My boots are…
Add one sentence about spots or stripes.
exercises.model: My mask is red. My cape is purple. My boots are pink. My gloves are black. My cape has got white stars.

items.say: Can you swim? Yes, I can.
Can you fly? No, I can't.

exercises.title: Can You? Yes, I Can!
lines: Can you jump? Yes, I can!
Can you run? Yes, I can!
Can you fly? No, I can't!
But I can help! Yes, I can!
Brave and strong, fast and high,
Little hero, touch the sky!

exercises.prompt: Draw a superhero with a super power. Is she fast? Is she strong? Can she fly? Write "She can …" under your picture.
exercises.ru: Нарисуй героя с суперсилой и подпиши: She can …

story.title: Meet the Team
paragraphs: Pip has got a hero team in Paris. Luc is a baker's son. He makes croissants every morning. His power: he can run very fast.
Zoé is a street artist. She draws on big walls. She can climb high. Mina is a coach from Star Academy. She is in Paris for one week. She can jump very high.
"And you, {name}?" asks Pip. "I can dance and sing!" says {name}. "Great!" says Mina. "Welcome to the team!"

exercises.videoTitle: Open the grammar videos and find a video about "can". Watch it.

options: things we are able to do

questions.q: What is the short form of "cannot"?

exercises.prompt: Write about one friend in the hero team.

steps: Draw a small map: your home, a park, a bakery and a café.

story.title: Mission: The Lost Puppy
paragraphs: Pip has got a mission. "A little girl is sad. Her puppy is lost in the park. It's small and brown with a white ear."
{name} goes to the park. There is a café opposite the park. She looks in front of the café. No puppy. She looks next to the big tree. No puppy.
Then she hears a little sound. The puppy is behind a green bench! {name} gives the puppy to the girl. "Thank you!" says the girl. Mission complete!

exercises.title: Copy the Mission Message
exercises.task: Copy Pip's secret mission message neatly.
exercises.ru: Аккуратно перепиши секретное сообщение от Пип.
steps: Copy the message in your best handwriting.
Underline next to, opposite and behind.
Draw a small puppy at the end.
exercises.model: Secret mission! A little puppy is lost. Look in the park. The park is opposite the café. Look behind the bench and next to the big tree. Good luck, hero!

story.title: The Kite Mission
paragraphs: It is a windy day in Paris. A boy has got a beautiful blue kite. Oh no! The wind takes the kite. Now it is on the Eiffel Tower!
"I can help!" says {name}. Zoé can climb high, and {name} can jump very high. They run over the bridge. Under the bridge there is a river with boats.
{name} jumps and Zoé climbs. Zoé takes the kite. They give it to the boy. He is very happy. "You are heroes!" he says.

items.sentence: The kite is on the tower.
There are boats on the river.

exercises.title: Up, Up, Eiffel Tower!
lines: Up, up, the Eiffel Tower,
Hero team with hero power!
Over the bridge, over the river,
Save the kite, never shiver!
Spots on! Mission on!
Hero team is never gone!

exercises.prompt: Draw the Eiffel Tower, a river and a bridge. Draw a blue kite at the top of the tower and two heroes!
exercises.ru: Нарисуй Эйфелеву башню, реку, мост и синего змея наверху башни.

Write 3–4 sentences: where you are, what there is, what you can do.
Finish with Love, and your name.

story.title: Mission: The Street Lamp
paragraphs: It is evening. Luc is sad. "The street lamp next to our bakery is broken. The street is very dark!"
Pip looks at the map. "Go straight on. Turn right at the café. The lamp is between the bakery and the shop."
{name} and Luc run there. {name} climbs up and fixes the lamp. Now the street is bright! Luc gives {name} a warm croissant. "Thank you, hero!"

options: between the bakery and the shop

items.text: Go straight on and turn left.
There is a bakery opposite the park.

story.title: The Painting in the Museum
paragraphs: Pip has got the last mission. "A painting is lost in the museum! It is a picture of a yellow flower."
The hero team goes to the museum. It is opposite the river. Zoé knows paintings. She looks in the big room. Luc runs fast up the stairs. Mina looks behind the door.
{name} sees something next to a window: the yellow flower painting! "Here it is!" The museum man is very happy. Pip says: "{name}, you are a real hero of Paris!"
